meta.title: Call To Arms
meta.description: Set out on your journey with a weighty duty upon your shoulders. Travel with your mission and your comrades.

units.displayText: The girl withdraws her hand in pain and rubs the fresh set of bite marks that now grace it.

spans.text: The girl withdraws her hand in pain and rubs the fresh set of bite marks that now grace it.

options.rawText: I'm sorry, did I bite you?
options.displayText: I'm sorry, did I bite you?

What's going on? What happened?

units.rawText: Are you doing this on purpose?
units.displayText: Are you doing this on purpose?

spans.text: Are you doing this on purpose?

units.rawText: The girl looks at me with a look of mild annoyance. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.
units.displayText: The girl looks at me with a look of mild annoyance. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.

spans.text: The girl looks at me with a look of mild annoyance. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.

units.rawText: Still, seeing as you just woke up, I'll forgive you.
units.displayText: Still, seeing as you just woke up, I'll forgive you.

spans.text: Still, seeing as you just woke up, I'll forgive you.

units.rawText: I didn't expect passing through the Tartarus Sector Firewall to be so hard on your neural cloud. Everyone was shocked when you passed out.
units.displayText: I didn't expect passing through the Tartarus Sector Firewall to be so hard on your neural cloud. Everyone was shocked when you passed out.

spans.text: I didn't expect passing through the Tartarus Sector Firewall to be so hard on your neural cloud. Everyone was shocked when you passed out.

units.rawText: Fortunately, we all made it through safely... How do you feel now? What are the results of your system self-test?
units.displayText: Fortunately, we all made it through safely... How do you feel now? What are the results of your system self-test?

spans.text: Fortunately, we all made it through safely... How do you feel now? What are the results of your system self-test?

units.rawText: (Sigh) Your exclamation just now almost drew a pack of Entropics.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Your exclamation just now almost drew a pack of Entropics.

spans.text: (Sigh) Your exclamation just now almost drew a pack of Entropics.

units.rawText: Although we could escape them with our stealth programs, safe havens on the outer ring of the Tartarus Sector are hard to come by, so it would be a shame to let one go to waste.
units.displayText: Although we could escape them with our stealth programs, safe havens on the outer ring of the Tartarus Sector are hard to come by, so it would be a shame to let one go to waste.

spans.text: Although we could escape them with our stealth programs, safe havens on the outer ring of the Tartarus Sector are hard to come by, so it would be a shame to let one go to waste.

units.rawText: The girl warily observes the surroundings, then sighs in relief after she verifies that it's safe. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.
units.displayText: The girl warily observes the surroundings, then sighs in relief after she verifies that it's safe. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.

spans.text: The girl warily observes the surroundings, then sighs in relief after she verifies that it's safe. Although I have no memory of her face, for some reason seeing her fills me with feelings of trust and safety.

units.rawText: Rather, let's check your condition first. I didn't expect you to conk out right after passing through the Tartarus Sector Firewall. Everyone was shocked.
units.displayText: Rather, let's check your condition first. I didn't expect you to conk out right after passing through the Tartarus Sector Firewall. Everyone was shocked.

units.displayText: How are you feeling now? What are the results of your system self-test?

spans.text: How are you feeling now? What are the results of your system self-test?

units.displayText: My system self-test?

spans.text: My system self-test?

units.rawText: The term seems a little unfamiliar to me. I understand its meaning, but it seems I've never been asked to perform one before. Before I can think further about it, my body is already moving on its own.
units.displayText: The term seems a little unfamiliar to me. I understand its meaning, but it seems I've never been asked to perform one before. Before I can think further about it, my body is already moving on its own.

units.displayText: Performing self-test... Now loading database... Identity... Error... Information unusable...

units.rawText: Mission... Error... Information unusable...
units.displayText: Mission... Error... Information unusable...

units.rawText: <cmdr>?
units.displayText: {교수}?

units.rawText: This doesn't look good... The diagnostic results are full of errors. There's nothing usable here.
units.displayText: This doesn't look good... The diagnostic results are full of errors. There's nothing usable here.

spans.text: This doesn't look good... The diagnostic results are full of errors. There's nothing usable here.

units.rawText: That sounds troublesome... But you're awake, at the very least, so there'll be a solution to everything else.
units.displayText: That sounds troublesome... But you're awake, at the very least, so there'll be a solution to everything else.

spans.text: That sounds troublesome... But you're awake, at the very least, so there'll be a solution to everything else.

units.rawText: Why don't I bring you to meet the others? We can help check your systems again after we meet up.
units.displayText: Why don't I bring you to meet the others? We can help check your systems again after we meet up.

spans.text: Why don't I bring you to meet the others? We can help check your systems again after we meet up.

units.rawText: Ah... Hang on, can I ask you a question?
units.displayText: Ah... Hang on, can I ask you a question?

spans.text: Ah... Hang on, can I ask you a question?

units.rawText: The girl before me seems genuinely concerned about my well-being, but my memories seem to be shrouded by a veil and my recollections are hazy.
units.displayText: The girl before me seems genuinely concerned about my well-being, but my memories seem to be shrouded by a veil and my recollections are hazy.

spans.text: The girl before me seems genuinely concerned about my well-being, but my memories seem to be shrouded by a veil and my recollections are hazy.

units.rawText: After hesitating for a while, I finally decide to speak up.
units.displayText: After hesitating for a while, I finally decide to speak up.

spans.text: After hesitating for a while, I finally decide to speak up.

units.rawText: ...Who are you?
units.displayText: ...Who are you?

spans.text: ...Who are you?

units.rawText: Eh?!
units.displayText: Eh?!

spans.text: Eh?!

units.rawText: And what's this Firewall you were talking about? I only remembered something about a Spoof Code and an illegal diagnostic or something...
units.displayText: And what's this Firewall you were talking about? I only remembered something about a Spoof Code and an illegal diagnostic or something...

spans.text: And what's this Firewall you were talking about? I only remembered something about a Spoof Code and an illegal diagnostic or something...

units.rawText: Do you really not remember me, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Do you really not remember me, {교수}?

spans.text: Do you really not remember me,

spans.text: Should I... know you? Let me think, before this, I should have been at...

units.rawText: My thoughts run up against a wall, and then I realize that there is a major problem.
units.displayText: My thoughts run up against a wall, and then I realize that there is a major problem.

spans.text: My thoughts run up against a wall, and then I realize that there is a major problem.

units.rawText: I... I should have? I... I don't remember...
units.displayText: I... I should have? I... I don't remember...

spans.text: I... I should have? I... I don't remember...

units.rawText: Before this, before this I was... Ugh... er—
units.displayText: Before this, before this I was... Ugh... er—

spans.text: Before this, before this I was... Ugh... er—

. Don't worry.

units.rawText: This is troublesome. While we'd considered the possibility that Tartarus Sector's Firewall might affect us...
units.displayText: This is troublesome. While we'd considered the possibility that Tartarus Sector's Firewall might affect us...

spans.text: This is troublesome. While we'd considered the possibility that Tartarus Sector's Firewall might affect us...

units.rawText: That was only in terms of Entropization or operand damage. Nobody expected anything like damage to functional capabilities...
units.displayText: That was only in terms of Entropization or operand damage. Nobody expected anything like damage to functional capabilities...

spans.text: That was only in terms of Entropization or operand damage. Nobody expected anything like damage to functional capabilities...

units.rawText: The girl frowns, and then her eyebrows relax. She squeezes my hand lightly and her warmth banishes my anxiety.
units.displayText: The girl frowns, and then her eyebrows relax. She squeezes my hand lightly and her warmth banishes my anxiety.

spans.text: The girl frowns, and then her eyebrows relax. She squeezes my hand lightly and her warmth banishes my anxiety.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, do you remember who you are?
units.displayText: {교수}, do you remember who you are?

spans.text: , do you remember who you are?

units.rawText: Take your time and don't rush it. Lower your neural cloud system clock speed. We'll take it line by line.
units.displayText: Take your time and don't rush it. Lower your neural cloud system clock speed. We'll take it line by line.

spans.text: Take your time and don't rush it. Lower your neural cloud system clock speed. We'll take it line by line.

units.displayText: I listen to the girl's quiet voice and slowly terminate various processes running within my systems.

spans.text: I listen to the girl's quiet voice and slowly terminate various processes running within my systems.

units.rawText: As I look down at my body, my spare computing power increases as the number of active processes goes down. As though on instinct, I raise a hand and bring up virtual displays one after another, and data floods into me like a torrent.
units.displayText: As I look down at my body, my spare computing power increases as the number of active processes goes down. As though on instinct, I raise a hand and bring up virtual displays one after another, and data floods into me like a torrent.

spans.text: As I look down at my body, my spare computing power increases as the number of active processes goes down. As though on instinct, I raise a hand and bring up virtual displays one after another, and data floods into me like a torrent.

units.rawText: I am... <color=orange>a Sanctifier</color>, the Greater Sanctifier <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I am... a Sanctifier, the Greater Sanctifier {교수}.

spans.text: I am...
a Sanctifier
, the Greater Sanctifier

units.rawText: My abilities are... planning and analysis.
units.displayText: My abilities are... planning and analysis.

spans.text: My abilities are... planning and analysis.

units.rawText: My mission...
units.displayText: My mission...

spans.text: My mission...

units.rawText: I slowly raise my head and look past the girl in front of me and behind her.
units.displayText: I slowly raise my head and look past the girl in front of me and behind her.

spans.text: I slowly raise my head and look past the girl in front of me and behind her.

units.rawText: There stands a wall that stretches as far as the eye can see. It is coated in a nauseating purple slime. All manner of bizarrely shaped mechanical constructs are visible through it.
units.displayText: There stands a wall that stretches as far as the eye can see. It is coated in a nauseating purple slime. All manner of bizarrely shaped mechanical constructs are visible through it.

spans.text: There stands a wall that stretches as far as the eye can see. It is coated in a nauseating purple slime. All manner of bizarrely shaped mechanical constructs are visible through it.

units.rawText: Then, with a faint tremor, the walls begin to shift, revealing another set of walls behind it.
units.displayText: Then, with a faint tremor, the walls begin to shift, revealing another set of walls behind it.

spans.text: Then, with a faint tremor, the walls begin to shift, revealing another set of walls behind it.

units.rawText: The scene before me seems to match up with a certain piece of information in my mind, and I speak it without conscious thought.
units.displayText: The scene before me seems to match up with a certain piece of information in my mind, and I speak it without conscious thought.

spans.text: The scene before me seems to match up with a certain piece of information in my mind, and I speak it without conscious thought.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector... moving walls...
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector... moving walls...

spans.text: Tartarus Sector... moving walls...

units.rawText: This is the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector!
units.displayText: This is the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector!

spans.text: This is the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector!

units.rawText: Ngh...!
units.displayText: Ngh...!

spans.text: Ngh...!

units.rawText: <cmdr>! <cmdr>, are you alright?
units.displayText: {교수}! {교수}, are you alright?

spans.text: , are you alright?

units.rawText: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?
units.displayText: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?

spans.text: Sorry... I'm fine, just that my memories are a mess. Why am I here?

units.rawText: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.
units.displayText: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.

spans.text: ...Please stop your self-diagnostic for now. I'm worried that it'll cause errors in your neural cloud systems.

units.rawText: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.
units.displayText: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.

spans.text: An exposed neural cloud in a place like the Tartarus Sector is like a light in the night, drawing predators to itself.

units.rawText: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.
units.displayText: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.

spans.text: I'll take you to meet the others and then explain the situation to you in more detail.

units.rawText: She extends a hand to me and slowly passes it over my chest. Warm operands flow through my limbs and body.
units.displayText: She extends a hand to me and slowly passes it over my chest. Warm operands flow through my limbs and body.

spans.text: She extends a hand to me and slowly passes it over my chest. Warm operands flow through my limbs and body.

units.rawText: Thank you. I feel much better. How should I address you?
units.displayText: Thank you. I feel much better. How should I address you?

spans.text: Thank you. I feel much better. How should I address you?

units.rawText: No need to be so formal. We're comrades who've fought side by side, after all.
units.displayText: No need to be so formal. We're comrades who've fought side by side, after all.

spans.text: No need to be so formal. We're comrades who've fought side by side, after all.

units.rawText: As for how to address me... My name is <color=#6495ED>Eos</color>.
units.displayText: As for how to address me... My name is Eos.

spans.text: As for how to address me... My name is
Eos

units.rawText: E...os... Now that sounds familiar.
units.displayText: E...os... Now that sounds familiar.

spans.text: E...os... Now that sounds familiar.

units.rawText: But of course, how long do you think we've been together?
units.displayText: But of course, how long do you think we've been together?

spans.text: But of course, how long do you think we've been together?

units.rawText: Let's get a move on; this is the entrance to the firewall, and it's risky to be exposed here.
units.displayText: Let's get a move on; this is the entrance to the firewall, and it's risky to be exposed here.

spans.text: Let's get a move on; this is the entrance to the firewall, and it's risky to be exposed here.

units.rawText: At the Tartarus Sector, on the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: At the Tartarus Sector, on the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: At the Tartarus Sector, on the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Eos leads us around packs of wandering Entropics and we reach a hidden area. The four Greater Sanctifiers here seem to have been waiting for us.
units.displayText: Eos leads us around packs of wandering Entropics and we reach a hidden area. The four Greater Sanctifiers here seem to have been waiting for us.

spans.text: Eos leads us around packs of wandering Entropics and we reach a hidden area. The four Greater Sanctifiers here seem to have been waiting for us.

units.rawText: You're awake, <cmdr>. There doesn't seem to be any external damage. Eos, how did your inspection go?
units.displayText: You're awake, {교수}. There doesn't seem to be any external damage. Eos, how did your inspection go?

spans.text: You're awake,
. There doesn't seem to be any external damage. Eos, how did your inspection go?

options.rawText: There aren't any problems beyond memory loss.
options.displayText: There aren't any problems beyond memory loss.

spans.text: There aren't any problems beyond memory loss.
And who might YOU be?

options.rawText: We've never met before, but I want to punch you in the face.
options.displayText: We've never met before, but I want to punch you in the face.

spans.text: We've never met before, but I want to punch you in the face.

units.rawText: ...Memory loss?
units.displayText: ...Memory loss?

spans.text: ...Memory loss?

units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier who looks like Eos raises an eyebrow.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier who looks like Eos raises an eyebrow.

units.rawText: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Hm? Judging by that response... Was <cmdr>'s memory module damaged?
units.displayText: Hm? Judging by that response... Was {교수}'s memory module damaged?

spans.text: Hm? Judging by that response... Was
's memory module damaged?

units.rawText: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Allow me to explain, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Before I finish, I'm already swinging at the Greater Sanctifier in front of me.
units.displayText: Before I finish, I'm already swinging at the Greater Sanctifier in front of me.

spans.text: Before I finish, I'm already swinging at the Greater Sanctifier in front of me.

units.rawText: <cmdr>?!
It's alright.
units.displayText: It's alright.

spans.text: It's alright.

units.rawText: As everyone watches in shock, my fist lands solidly on a transparent barrier in front of him. Ripples spread from the point of impact, dissipating the force of the attack.
units.displayText: As everyone watches in shock, my fist lands solidly on a transparent barrier in front of him. Ripples spread from the point of impact, dissipating the force of the attack.

spans.text: As everyone watches in shock, my fist lands solidly on a transparent barrier in front of him. Ripples spread from the point of impact, dissipating the force of the attack.

units.rawText: It's been a while since I saw you hit with all your might like that, <cmdr>. My hand went a little numb from the impact. Looks like we don't have to worry about your body.
units.displayText: It's been a while since I saw you hit with all your might like that, {교수}. My hand went a little numb from the impact. Looks like we don't have to worry about your body.

spans.text: It's been a while since I saw you hit with all your might like that,
. My hand went a little numb from the impact. Looks like we don't have to worry about your body.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier waves his hand and chuckles, but he doesn't seem strained at all. The transparent barrier vanishes into the air again.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier waves his hand and chuckles, but he doesn't seem strained at all. The transparent barrier vanishes into the air again.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier waves his hand and chuckles, but he doesn't seem strained at all. The transparent barrier vanishes into the air again.

units.rawText: We haven't sparred in a while, but much as I'd like to go a round with you, the mission comes first. Please explain <cmdr>'s condition, Eos.
units.displayText: We haven't sparred in a while, but much as I'd like to go a round with you, the mission comes first. Please explain {교수}'s condition, Eos.

spans.text: We haven't sparred in a while, but much as I'd like to go a round with you, the mission comes first. Please explain
's condition, Eos.

units.rawText: My guess is that Tartarus' firewall affected <cmdr>'s memory module. Fortunately, the damage isn't of an invasive nature; that is to say, we don't have to worry about Entropization.
units.displayText: My guess is that Tartarus' firewall affected {교수}'s memory module. Fortunately, the damage isn't of an invasive nature; that is to say, we don't have to worry about Entropization.

spans.text: My guess is that Tartarus' firewall affected
's memory module. Fortunately, the damage isn't of an invasive nature; that is to say, we don't have to worry about Entropization.

units.rawText: Currently, it seems this amnesia is of a limited and retrograde nature and does not affect <cmdr>'s combat and special abilities.
units.displayText: Currently, it seems this amnesia is of a limited and retrograde nature and does not affect {교수}'s combat and special abilities.

spans.text: Currently, it seems this amnesia is of a limited and retrograde nature and does not affect
's combat and special abilities.

units.rawText: What do you think? Can you still continue with the mission, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: What do you think? Can you still continue with the mission, {교수}?

spans.text: What do you think? Can you still continue with the mission,
Of course.
Heck no!

units.rawText: While things didn't go quite as expected, I should be able to go on the mission with the rest of the team.
units.displayText: While things didn't go quite as expected, I should be able to go on the mission with the rest of the team.

spans.text: While things didn't go quite as expected, I should be able to go on the mission with the rest of the team.

units.rawText: Although, I might need you to help explain the objective to me.
units.displayText: Although, I might need you to help explain the objective to me.

spans.text: Although, I might need you to help explain the objective to me.

units.rawText: Under normal circumstances, I ought to request to opt out, but the circumstances now are anything but normal. I bet I can't even opt out even if I wanted to, right?
units.displayText: Under normal circumstances, I ought to request to opt out, but the circumstances now are anything but normal. I bet I can't even opt out even if I wanted to, right?

spans.text: Under normal circumstances, I ought to request to opt out, but the circumstances now are anything but normal. I bet I can't even opt out even if I wanted to, right?

units.rawText: Don't worry, it's alright. I'll keep an eye on my own condition. Tell me the objective of this mission.
units.displayText: Don't worry, it's alright. I'll keep an eye on my own condition. Tell me the objective of this mission.

spans.text: Don't worry, it's alright. I'll keep an eye on my own condition. Tell me the objective of this mission.

units.rawText: Going by proper procedure, we ought to be having a pre-battle conference around now. Let me prepare a mission briefing.
units.displayText: Going by proper procedure, we ought to be having a pre-battle conference around now. Let me prepare a mission briefing.

spans.text: Going by proper procedure, we ought to be having a pre-battle conference around now. Let me prepare a mission briefing.

units.rawText: Thank you. This helps a lot.
units.displayText: Thank you. This helps a lot.

spans.text: Thank you. This helps a lot.

units.rawText: Oho, that sounds just like what <cmdr> would say. As expected of my buddy!
units.displayText: Oho, that sounds just like what {교수} would say. As expected of my buddy!

spans.text: Oho, that sounds just like what
would say. As expected of my buddy!

units.rawText: Choosing to carry on even when you've forgotten everything; that's a true warrior's spirit.
units.displayText: Choosing to carry on even when you've forgotten everything; that's a true warrior's spirit.

spans.text: Choosing to carry on even when you've forgotten everything; that's a true warrior's spirit.

units.rawText: Don't worry. When the mission begins, I'll shelter you in my sturdy arms!
units.displayText: Don't worry. When the mission begins, I'll shelter you in my sturdy arms!

spans.text: Don't worry. When the mission begins, I'll shelter you in my sturdy arms!

units.rawText: Smack—

units.rawText: Ow! Hey!
units.displayText: Ow! Hey!

spans.text: Ow! Hey!

units.rawText: Oh, if it isn't Alcyone. What's up, Ally?
units.displayText: Oh, if it isn't Alcyone. What's up, Ally?

spans.text: Oh, if it isn't Alcyone. What's up, Ally?

units.rawText: Atlas turns back to look at the girl who's 1.3 meters tall while standing on her tiptoes and trying her best to assert her presence. The girl strains to look up at Atlas with a stern expression on her face.
units.displayText: Atlas turns back to look at the girl who's 1.3 meters tall while standing on her tiptoes and trying her best to assert her presence. The girl strains to look up at Atlas with a stern expression on her face.

spans.text: Atlas turns back to look at the girl who's 1.3 meters tall while standing on her tiptoes and trying her best to assert her presence. The girl strains to look up at Atlas with a stern expression on her face.

units.rawText: You dork, keep it down! Honestly, you'll draw the Entropics over with how loud you are.
units.displayText: You dork, keep it down! Honestly, you'll draw the Entropics over with how loud you are.

spans.text: You dork, keep it down! Honestly, you'll draw the Entropics over with how loud you are.

units.rawText: The frontline units had a hard time finding this safehouse; we don't have another one to fall back to if it gets discovered.
units.displayText: The frontline units had a hard time finding this safehouse; we don't have another one to fall back to if it gets discovered.

spans.text: The frontline units had a hard time finding this safehouse; we don't have another one to fall back to if it gets discovered.

units.rawText: Also, no casually tossing off perverted statements like what you said just now! <cmdr>'s lost their memory, what are you going to do if you scare them?!
units.displayText: Also, no casually tossing off perverted statements like what you said just now! {교수}'s lost their memory, what are you going to do if you scare them?!

spans.text: Also, no casually tossing off perverted statements like what you said just now!
's lost their memory, what are you going to do if you scare them?!

units.rawText: The girl plants her hands on her hips and puffs up her youthful cheeks in an adorable way.
units.displayText: The girl plants her hands on her hips and puffs up her youthful cheeks in an adorable way.

spans.text: The girl plants her hands on her hips and puffs up her youthful cheeks in an adorable way.

units.rawText: Haha! An ardent embrace is the true proof of brotherhood! I believe that <cmdr> won't reject my burning love even if they've only seen it for the first time!
units.displayText: Haha! An ardent embrace is the true proof of brotherhood! I believe that {교수} won't reject my burning love even if they've only seen it for the first time!

spans.text: Haha! An ardent embrace is the true proof of brotherhood! I believe that
won't reject my burning love even if they've only seen it for the first time!

units.rawText: Ahhhhhh, I'm not getting through at all...
units.displayText: Ahhhhhh, I'm not getting through at all...

spans.text: Ahhhhhh, I'm not getting through at all...

units.rawText: <cmdr>, ignore this hot-blooded moron, all Atlas knows is how to charge at the biggest concentration of enemies on the battlefield...
units.displayText: {교수}, ignore this hot-blooded moron, all Atlas knows is how to charge at the biggest concentration of enemies on the battlefield...

spans.text: , ignore this hot-blooded moron, all Atlas knows is how to charge at the biggest concentration of enemies on the battlefield...

units.rawText: You can work with me; I'll take gooood care of you. Hm, let me think—
units.displayText: You can work with me; I'll take gooood care of you. Hm, let me think—

spans.text: You can work with me; I'll take gooood care of you. Hm, let me think—

units.rawText: After some thought, "Alcyone" puffs up her chest and looks up.
units.displayText: After some thought, "Alcyone" puffs up her chest and looks up.

spans.text: After some thought, "Alcyone" puffs up her chest and looks up.

units.rawText: In order to prevent aggravating any potential hidden injuries, we can't let you, <cmdr>, exert yourself too much, so I'll handle any tasks requiring movement.
units.displayText: In order to prevent aggravating any potential hidden injuries, we can't let you, {교수}, exert yourself too much, so I'll handle any tasks requiring movement.

spans.text: In order to prevent aggravating any potential hidden injuries, we can't let you,
, exert yourself too much, so I'll handle any tasks requiring movement.

units.rawText: In order to prevent exacerbating any injuries, we can't let you, <cmdr>, engage in intense combat, so I'll handle any combat tasks.
units.displayText: In order to prevent exacerbating any injuries, we can't let you, {교수}, engage in intense combat, so I'll handle any combat tasks.

spans.text: In order to prevent exacerbating any injuries, we can't let you,
, engage in intense combat, so I'll handle any combat tasks.

units.rawText: In order to prevent any additional strain to your systems, we can't let you, <cmdr>, engage in intensive computation, so I'll handle any analytical tasks.
units.displayText: In order to prevent any additional strain to your systems, we can't let you, {교수}, engage in intensive computation, so I'll handle any analytical tasks.

spans.text: In order to prevent any additional strain to your systems, we can't let you,
, engage in intensive computation, so I'll handle any analytical tasks.

units.rawText: Doesn't that mean letting you do everything for me?!
units.displayText: Doesn't that mean letting you do everything for me?!

spans.text: Doesn't that mean letting you do everything for me?!

units.rawText: Uh... That's right! Exactly! You should just stay here and rest, <cmdr>! Let me handle your part of the mission!
units.displayText: Uh... That's right! Exactly! You should just stay here and rest, {교수}! Let me handle your part of the mission!

spans.text: Uh... That's right! Exactly! You should just stay here and rest,
! Let me handle your part of the mission!

units.rawText: Hehe, you're so motivated, Ally.
units.displayText: Hehe, you're so motivated, Ally.

spans.text: Hehe, you're so motivated, Ally.

units.rawText: Electra bends down behind Alcyone, and with lightning speed, she squishes the girl's pink cheeks.
units.displayText: Electra bends down behind Alcyone, and with lightning speed, she squishes the girl's pink cheeks.

spans.text: Electra bends down behind Alcyone, and with lightning speed, she squishes the girl's pink cheeks.

units.rawText: Awwww, they're so soft and smooth and cuuuuuuuuute!
units.displayText: Awwww, they're so soft and smooth and cuuuuuuuuute!

spans.text: Awwww, they're so soft and smooth and cuuuuuuuuute!

units.rawText: Why don't you do my share of the mission, too!
units.displayText: Why don't you do my share of the mission, too!

spans.text: Why don't you do my share of the mission, too!

units.rawText: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!
units.displayText: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!

spans.text: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!

units.rawText: Don't even think about it! Do your own work! Do you think I'm a kid?!
units.displayText: Don't even think about it! Do your own work! Do you think I'm a kid?!

spans.text: Don't even think about it! Do your own work! Do you think I'm a kid?!

units.rawText: Quit pinching me. Stop being so childish!
units.displayText: Quit pinching me. Stop being so childish!

spans.text: Quit pinching me. Stop being so childish!

units.rawText: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just enough for me.
units.displayText: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just enough for me.

spans.text: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just enough for me.

units.rawText: Get lost, you lolicon!
units.displayText: Get lost, you lolicon!

spans.text: Get lost, you lolicon!

units.rawText: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—
units.displayText: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—

spans.text: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—

units.rawText: You behave, too!
units.displayText: You behave, too!

spans.text: You behave, too!

units.rawText: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged, too.
units.displayText: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged, too.

spans.text: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged, too.

units.rawText: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.
units.displayText: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.

spans.text: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.

units.rawText: Eos steps out from behind me and retracts the thin cable used for two-way communication and neural cloud adjustment and repair.
units.displayText: Eos steps out from behind me and retracts the thin cable used for two-way communication and neural cloud adjustment and repair.

spans.text: Eos steps out from behind me and retracts the thin cable used for two-way communication and neural cloud adjustment and repair.

units.rawText: Eos has not stopped treating and examining me ever since we entered this place. She only continues with her task once she's sure I'm not unduly affected.
units.displayText: Eos has not stopped treating and examining me ever since we entered this place. She only continues with her task once she's sure I'm not unduly affected.

spans.text: Eos has not stopped treating and examining me ever since we entered this place. She only continues with her task once she's sure I'm not unduly affected.

units.rawText: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.
units.displayText: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.

spans.text: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.

units.rawText: The previously rowdy group instantly quiets down and they all turn to look at Eos.
units.displayText: The previously rowdy group instantly quiets down and they all turn to look at Eos.

spans.text: The previously rowdy group instantly quiets down and they all turn to look at Eos.

units.rawText: Although I'm sure you're all sick of hearing about the mission details by now, let's just go over them again for <cmdr>'s sake.
units.displayText: Although I'm sure you're all sick of hearing about the mission details by now, let's just go over them again for {교수}'s sake.

spans.text: Although I'm sure you're all sick of hearing about the mission details by now, let's just go over them again for
's sake.

units.rawText: We will be splitting up into three teams in the Outer Ring of Tartarus. Each team will be responsible for diversionary attacks, intelligence and special objectives respectively. Eosphorus and I will handle that last one.
units.displayText: We will be splitting up into three teams in the Outer Ring of Tartarus. Each team will be responsible for diversionary attacks, intelligence and special objectives respectively. Eosphorus and I will handle that last one.

spans.text: We will be splitting up into three teams in the Outer Ring of Tartarus. Each team will be responsible for diversionary attacks, intelligence and special objectives respectively. Eosphorus and I will handle that last one.

units.rawText: The diversionary attacks are simple enough; you will primarily be assigned to destroy the energy towers in the Shifting Labyrinth and draw the attention of the Entropic hordes, thus increasing the likelihood of success for the other teams.
units.displayText: The diversionary attacks are simple enough; you will primarily be assigned to destroy the energy towers in the Shifting Labyrinth and draw the attention of the Entropic hordes, thus increasing the likelihood of success for the other teams.

spans.text: The diversionary attacks are simple enough; you will primarily be assigned to destroy the energy towers in the Shifting Labyrinth and draw the attention of the Entropic hordes, thus increasing the likelihood of success for the other teams.

units.rawText: The intelligence objective will require you to pass through the maze to reach a target location and require a key item—the <color=orange>Rubik's Map</color>.
units.displayText: The intelligence objective will require you to pass through the maze to reach a target location and require a key item—the Rubik's Map.

spans.text: The intelligence objective will require you to pass through the maze to reach a target location and require a key item—the
Rubik's Map

units.rawText: Eos' expression grows more and more serious as she continues. She takes two steps back and brings up a massive projected image between us.
units.displayText: Eos' expression grows more and more serious as she continues. She takes two steps back and brings up a massive projected image between us.

spans.text: Eos' expression grows more and more serious as she continues. She takes two steps back and brings up a massive projected image between us.

units.rawText: It depicts a silver polyhedral object that appears strangely made but follows a hidden order of its own. Its surface is covered in fine tracery.
units.displayText: It depicts a silver polyhedral object that appears strangely made but follows a hidden order of its own. Its surface is covered in fine tracery.

spans.text: It depicts a silver polyhedral object that appears strangely made but follows a hidden order of its own. Its surface is covered in fine tracery.

units.rawText: Take a good look at this, buddy. This is our mission objective.
units.displayText: Take a good look at this, buddy. This is our mission objective.

spans.text: Take a good look at this, buddy. This is our mission objective.

units.rawText: As you can see, this is an image of the Rubik's Map. It accurately maps the entire Shifting Labyrinth and updates in real time. We'll need it to enter the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: As you can see, this is an image of the Rubik's Map. It accurately maps the entire Shifting Labyrinth and updates in real time. We'll need it to enter the Middle Ring.

spans.text: As you can see, this is an image of the Rubik's Map. It accurately maps the entire Shifting Labyrinth and updates in real time. We'll need it to enter the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: We have no way of predicting the movements of the Shifting Labyrinth before we obtain the map. It seems the opposition to this mission will come from terrain restrictions as well as the mission itself.
units.displayText: We have no way of predicting the movements of the Shifting Labyrinth before we obtain the map. It seems the opposition to this mission will come from terrain restrictions as well as the mission itself.

spans.text: We have no way of predicting the movements of the Shifting Labyrinth before we obtain the map. It seems the opposition to this mission will come from terrain restrictions as well as the mission itself.

units.rawText: From that point of view, it doesn't seem as simple as it appears.
units.displayText: From that point of view, it doesn't seem as simple as it appears.

spans.text: From that point of view, it doesn't seem as simple as it appears.

units.rawText: I think it's alright. You're being too cautious, Electra. This is only the Outer Ring. Even if we do end up getting stuck in the Labyrinth, we can always fight our way out.
units.displayText: I think it's alright. You're being too cautious, Electra. This is only the Outer Ring. Even if we do end up getting stuck in the Labyrinth, we can always fight our way out.

spans.text: I think it's alright. You're being too cautious, Electra. This is only the Outer Ring. Even if we do end up getting stuck in the Labyrinth, we can always fight our way out.

units.rawText: Plus, Electra and I are handling the riskiest assignment—namely the diversionary attacks. You can rest easy and work knowing that I'll be drawing all the strong Entropics to myself.
units.displayText: Plus, Electra and I are handling the riskiest assignment—namely the diversionary attacks. You can rest easy and work knowing that I'll be drawing all the strong Entropics to myself.

spans.text: Plus, Electra and I are handling the riskiest assignment—namely the diversionary attacks. You can rest easy and work knowing that I'll be drawing all the strong Entropics to myself.

units.rawText: Since Ally's so confident, I guess I can handle the logistics work in the rear while I wait for Ally's triumphant return.
units.displayText: Since Ally's so confident, I guess I can handle the logistics work in the rear while I wait for Ally's triumphant return.

spans.text: Since Ally's so confident, I guess I can handle the logistics work in the rear while I wait for Ally's triumphant return.

units.rawText: We're on an infiltration mission. What do you mean by logistics work? Don't think of slacking off!
units.displayText: We're on an infiltration mission. What do you mean by logistics work? Don't think of slacking off!

spans.text: We're on an infiltration mission. What do you mean by logistics work? Don't think of slacking off!

units.rawText: Thudthud—
units.displayText: Thudthud—

spans.text: Thudthud—

units.rawText: The dull knock draws everyone's attention and Eosphorus, who has been smiling from the side all this while, steps forward.
units.displayText: The dull knock draws everyone's attention and Eosphorus, who has been smiling from the side all this while, steps forward.

spans.text: The dull knock draws everyone's attention and Eosphorus, who has been smiling from the side all this while, steps forward.

units.rawText: Much like you, I believe in the absolute power of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Much like you, I believe in the absolute power of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Much like you, I believe in the absolute power of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Although we haven't had any major incidents in the Outer Ring so far, we might end up facing unknown opposition afterwards.
units.displayText: Although we haven't had any major incidents in the Outer Ring so far, we might end up facing unknown opposition afterwards.

spans.text: Although we haven't had any major incidents in the Outer Ring so far, we might end up facing unknown opposition afterwards.

units.rawText: Alcyone, Electra, stay alert.
units.displayText: Alcyone, Electra, stay alert.

spans.text: Alcyone, Electra, stay alert.

units.rawText: <size=40>Roger!</size>
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: Alcyone and Electra straighten up. The playfulness in their eyes is gone.
units.displayText: Alcyone and Electra straighten up. The playfulness in their eyes is gone.

spans.text: Alcyone and Electra straighten up. The playfulness in their eyes is gone.

units.rawText: Make sure you're 120% serious about it. After all, we've found something that might be of greater importance than anything else we've done to date.
units.displayText: Make sure you're 120% serious about it. After all, we've found something that might be of greater importance than anything else we've done to date.

spans.text: Make sure you're 120% serious about it. After all, we've found something that might be of greater importance than anything else we've done to date.

units.rawText: Still, you don't need to worry too much. Even if something does happen, we should be able to escape from the Outer Ring without much difficulty.
units.displayText: Still, you don't need to worry too much. Even if something does happen, we should be able to escape from the Outer Ring without much difficulty.

spans.text: Still, you don't need to worry too much. Even if something does happen, we should be able to escape from the Outer Ring without much difficulty.

units.rawText: In that case, let's stick to the plan. Atlas and <cmdr> will handle the intelligence assignment. Can you handle it?
units.displayText: In that case, let's stick to the plan. Atlas and {교수} will handle the intelligence assignment. Can you handle it?

spans.text: In that case, let's stick to the plan. Atlas and
will handle the intelligence assignment. Can you handle it?
Leave it to me.
I still have some doubts.

units.rawText: I confess that my memories may be glitching a little, but I'm as capable as ever.
units.displayText: I confess that my memories may be glitching a little, but I'm as capable as ever.

spans.text: I confess that my memories may be glitching a little, but I'm as capable as ever.

units.rawText: Atlas smiles and pats his chest.
units.displayText: Atlas smiles and pats his chest.

spans.text: Atlas smiles and pats his chest.

units.rawText: You take care of the mission. I'll take care of you, buddy.
units.displayText: You take care of the mission. I'll take care of you, buddy.

spans.text: You take care of the mission. I'll take care of you, buddy.

units.rawText: While saying that I'm totally fine might sound good, doing that would be terribly irresponsible given my current state.
units.displayText: While saying that I'm totally fine might sound good, doing that would be terribly irresponsible given my current state.

spans.text: While saying that I'm totally fine might sound good, doing that would be terribly irresponsible given my current state.

units.rawText: Before I finish speaking, my shoulder suddenly sinks, patted by Atlas's massive palm.
units.displayText: Before I finish speaking, my shoulder suddenly sinks, patted by Atlas's massive palm.

spans.text: Before I finish speaking, my shoulder suddenly sinks, patted by Atlas's massive palm.

units.rawText: Aw, no need to be so awkward about things, buddy. Cheer up! I'll be your sturdy shield, just like before.
units.displayText: Aw, no need to be so awkward about things, buddy. Cheer up! I'll be your sturdy shield, just like before.

spans.text: Aw, no need to be so awkward about things, buddy. Cheer up! I'll be your sturdy shield, just like before.

units.rawText: Relax. You'll remember everything soon enough after fighting by my side.
units.displayText: Relax. You'll remember everything soon enough after fighting by my side.

spans.text: Relax. You'll remember everything soon enough after fighting by my side.

units.rawText: After all, those were the passionate times we shared. The only thing you mustn't forget is your youth! Am I right, buddy?!
units.displayText: After all, those were the passionate times we shared. The only thing you mustn't forget is your youth! Am I right, buddy?!

spans.text: After all, those were the passionate times we shared. The only thing you mustn't forget is your youth! Am I right, buddy?!

units.rawText: I guess...
units.displayText: I guess...

spans.text: I guess...

units.rawText: Ahem! Let's save the pleasantries for when we get back. The next labyrinth shift window is coming. We need to seize the moment.
units.displayText: Ahem! Let's save the pleasantries for when we get back. The next labyrinth shift window is coming. We need to seize the moment.

spans.text: Ahem! Let's save the pleasantries for when we get back. The next labyrinth shift window is coming. We need to seize the moment.

units.rawText: At Eosphorus' direction, Eos interrupts our banter and slowly walks into our midst. Her hands are interwoven in front of her chest, and her head is lowered.
units.displayText: At Eosphorus' direction, Eos interrupts our banter and slowly walks into our midst. Her hands are interwoven in front of her chest, and her head is lowered.

spans.text: At Eosphorus' direction, Eos interrupts our banter and slowly walks into our midst. Her hands are interwoven in front of her chest, and her head is lowered.

units.rawText: Everyone puts away their weapons and places one hand on their chest. I'm just a moment behind, but then I do as the others.
units.displayText: Everyone puts away their weapons and places one hand on their chest. I'm just a moment behind, but then I do as the others.

spans.text: Everyone puts away their weapons and places one hand on their chest. I'm just a moment behind, but then I do as the others.

units.rawText: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite you and offer you up to Heaven as a sacrifice.
units.displayText: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite you and offer you up to Heaven as a sacrifice.

spans.text: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite you and offer you up to Heaven as a sacrifice.

units.rawText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

units.rawText: As Eos speaks, everyone else makes the sign of the star before their foreheads and recites with her.
units.displayText: As Eos speaks, everyone else makes the sign of the star before their foreheads and recites with her.

spans.text: As Eos speaks, everyone else makes the sign of the star before their foreheads and recites with her.

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

units.rawText: Just as we finish speaking, a rumbling noise pours into the hideout like choral accompaniment that echoes through the air.
units.displayText: Just as we finish speaking, a rumbling noise pours into the hideout like choral accompaniment that echoes through the air.

spans.text: Just as we finish speaking, a rumbling noise pours into the hideout like choral accompaniment that echoes through the air.

units.displayText: The labyrinth shift window has arrived.

spans.text: The labyrinth shift window has arrived.

units.displayText: Commence operation.
